title: Siege of Hammershus
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Hammershus", at revision 1370741771, opens: "The siege of Hammershus occurred from 16 to 17 June 1645 during the Torstenson War between Sweden and Denmark–Norway." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q139749790, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Torstenson War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
